harnessCorrections.problem: The desktop stats check could accept the previous editor while managed launch was still asynchronous.
harnessCorrections.correction: Wait for both Viewer URLs to change, then require the new runtime session to be running.

harnessCorrections.problem: A fixed clipboard delay on a WAN could re-enable consent before the disabled-period offer arrived.
harnessCorrections.correction: Observe actual clipboard event delivery while consent is off, then re-enable; no product consent change.

limitations: Physical OS IME, native shortcut behavior and human UAT on the new target remain pending. CDP composition and synthetic key events do not establish physical OS behavior.
No UDP, speaker/microphone, rich clipboard, host-application integration or long-duration soak was qualified by this deployment.
Only the four Core executables are static. Kasm, shell, X11 applications, D-Bus and graphical libraries remain target dependencies.
The public fixture shares one authorized UAT identity; it is not multi-tenant production authentication.
This standalone Alpine run does not requalify systemd or prior-Core rollback; historical experiments retain their own scope.
The candidate remains a development UAT build, not a formal release or full D2 acceptance. Later evidence/test commits do not change the recorded Core/App artifact identities.
